text: Achoo! Achoo! Excuse me, captain. I'm Dr Nettle. The Sneezles has spread all over my planet, and everyone is sneezing bubbles. Even the mayor!
Empty shelves. I need Medicine and fresh Water, and I've run right out. You'll have to buy them at a market, but I'll pay much more than you spend.
Bubbles to the roof. Your quest list shows where to buy them and today's prices. Please hurry back, before the bubbles reach the roof!
Bless you, captain. The sneezing has stopped! Well, nearly. The mayor still does a tiny bubble now and then. He says it makes him feel fancy.
A tidy profit. Here's what I promised, captain, and a little extra. You saved the day, and you made a tidy profit too!
